summary: Update equipment timecard entry approval status
description: Update approval status of equipment timecard entries (pending, approved, reviewed, billed) for the given project. Supports bulk updates: pass an array of equipment timecard entry IDs and the desired approval_status. Billed entries cannot be changed to another status (except to keep as billed). Requires project Timesheets approval permission, or admin on the company Equipment Register tool while equipment-timesheet-company-view-enabled is on (the Equipment Utilization tab). When that flag is off, only the Timesheets approval check applies. Equipment Register read is not enough.

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Optional response blueprint view. Defaults to `default`.

200.description: Equipment timecard entries approval status updated successfully. Returns the updated entries in the v2 data envelope.

id.description: Primary key (REST v2 serializes numeric identifiers as strings)

approved_by_id.description: Identifier of the user who approved this entry. Null when unapproved.

approval_status.description: Approval workflow status for this entry.

approval_status_updated_at.description: Timestamp when the approval status was last changed, in ISO 8601 format.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company this entry belongs to.

client_local_id.description: Client-provided local identifier echoed in API responses for request/response correlation.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was created, in ISO 8601 format.

created_by_id.description: Identifier of the user who created this entry.

crew_id.description: Identifier of the crew assigned to this entry. Null if unassigned.

date.description: Date this equipment timecard entry applies to.

equipment_name.description: Display name from Equipment Register when available (company-scoped list).

equipment_identification_number.description: Identification number from Equipment Register when available (company-scoped list).

idle_quantity.description: Idle (non-operating) hours recorded for this entry.

location_id.description: Identifier of the location for this entry. Null if unassigned.

party_id.description: Identifier of the party (employee/contact) for this entry. Null if unassigned.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this entry belongs to.

project_name.description: Display name of the project identified by project_id. Null when the associated project cannot be resolved. Use to label entries without a separate request to the projects endpoint.

quantity.description: Operating hours recorded for this entry.

timesheet_id.description: Identifier of the timesheet this entry is linked to. Null if unlinked.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure for equipment hours (numeric enum).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_by_id.description: Identifier of the user who last updated this entry.

wbs_code_id.description: Identifier of the WBS/task code assigned to this entry. Null if unassigned.

origin_data.description: Data payload from an external/ERP integration, if linked.

origin_id.description: Identifier from an external/ERP system, if linked.

timesheet.description: Present when serializer_view=mobile; nested timesheet (TimesheetBlueprint normal view). Null when the entry has no timesheet.

timesheet_status.description: Present when serializer_view=mobile; same as timesheet.status when a timesheet is associated

400.description: Invalid approval_status value or empty ids array. Valid statuses are pending, approved, reviewed, billed.

403.description: Forbidden. User does not have permission to approve equipment timecard entries.

404.description: One or more equipment timecard entries not found or do not belong to the project.

422.description: Unprocessable entity. For example, attempting to change billed entries to a different status.

ids.description: Array of equipment timecard entry IDs to update

approval_status.description: The approval status to set for all specified entries
